Add schedule

Force DHW uses the same protected workflow as Dashboard. Conditions are evaluated from the latest Panasonic values at the scheduled minute. AND groups are evaluated before OR groups, so A AND B OR C AND D means (A AND B) OR (C AND D). For a DHW reserve, add DHW temperature, three-way valve = 0, and Force DHW = 0. If time or a value required by the expression is unavailable, nothing is sent.
